_readme: Committed derived data: OUR corrections to the pinned upstream card DB.
docs/data/ is generated and gitignored, so it cannot be hand-edited; this
table is merged at build time by tools/corrections.py, the same posture as
tools/data/enrichment.json. Every entry carries a 'why' so the next person
can re-check it without redoing the research. An entry that stops matching
is printed as unmatched at build time - that means upstream fixed it and
the entry should be deleted, not that the build is broken.

sets.why: Upstream split one scenario across two encounter-set spellings. The Quest cards sit on 'Journey Down the Anduin' (Core Set, 3 stages, pickable); 'Journey Along the Anduin' (Revised Core Set) holds strays and shows 0 stages, so quest_catalog.group_by_cycle's stageCount>0 filter hides it. Unifying merges them. Unify onto the DOWN spelling, not the correct-per-Revised ALONG spelling, because the pickable slug journey-down-the-anduin is already a key in tools/data/enrichment.json and in saved games. tools/build_scenario_order.ALIASES still maps it to Hall of Beorn's 'along' and stays live.

The consequence bug, and the reason the base rename alone is not enough. build_card_data._has_nightmare probes slugify(encounterSet + ' - Nightmare'), so with the base set renamed to 'Down' and the Nightmare deck still named 'Along', the probe misses and the pickable Core Set quest advertises no Nightmare mode. Verified: hasNightmare was false on the pickable entry and true on the invisible 0-stage stub.

Same split. Quest cards sit on the ASCII 'Nibin-Dum' (Two-Player Limited Edition Starter, 4 stages, pickable); the circumflex spelling (Dark of Mirkwood) holds 2 treacheries and shows 0 stages. Unify onto the ASCII form: the correct spelling is Nibin-dum with a circumflex (Dark of Mirkwood rulebook), but the device font has no such glyph, and folding happens anyway - unifying here keeps the existing slug the-caves-of-nibin-dum rather than minting the-caves-of-nibin-d-m and orphaning saved games.

text.name: Great Spider
text.why: Transcription typo in the upstream TSV. The printed card reads 'Forced: After Great Spider engages you, exhaust a character you control.'

text.name: Goblintown Scavengers
text.why: Transcription typo; the card's own title two lines above is spelled correctly.

text.name: Wild Wargs
text.why: Transcription typo in 'discard the top card of the encounter deck'.

text.name: Mirkwood Forest
text.why: Quest stage cards are rows too, matched on the stage's own name. Typo on stage 2B, in the clause that gates the whole stage: 'cannot be defeated unless at least 1 copy of Goblin Trail is in the victory display'. Rules Reference spells the zone 'victory display'.

text.name: After the Raid
text.why: Transcription slip on stage 1A. Every other scenario's setup text reads 'Then, shuffle the encounter deck.'

_todo: Delimiter backticks are deliberately NOT rewritten. Of ~165 backticks in the catalog roughly half wrap nested card text ("it gains: `Response: ...`") rather than standing in for an apostrophe. Turning those into quotes is a presentation choice about how DragnCards quotes nested abilities, not a transcription fix, and needs its own decision.

Pre-Revised gendered wording ('his hand', 'with him', 'he controls') is left alone. FFG degendered card text for the Revised Core Set, but correcting it here is a rules claim under CLAUDE.md iron rule 4 and each instance needs a citation to the Revised printing before it can ship.
